title: Export scoped shipment and finance amount summaries to Excel
description: A sales user downloads the monetary summary shown by the shipment/finance report designer for the current authorized order page. Reuse ERP-162 finite SummaryMode and summary DTOs in ERP-156 bounded preview; add a separate amount-summary worksheet for supported non-none modes while preserving the existing selected-column data worksheet for none. Recheck current-user sales-order menu and SalespersonDataScopeService scope on each export; reject invalid modes before source reads and retain OperationLogMiddleware audit. Keep customer, original currency and optional shipment/finance status boundaries; null linked/uncovered/submitted evidence remains unknown with known/unknown row counts, and uncovered amount is not an AR balance. Development only: no arbitrary SQL, schema/migrations, production SQL or real database execution, business writes, secrets/.env changes, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused workbook tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Excel export reuses the ERP-162 authorized bounded current page and finite SummaryMode validation; none retains the existing selected-column worksheet.

Supported amount modes add a separate current-page summary worksheet keyed by customer, original currency and optional status, with numeric known totals, blank unknown linked/uncovered/submitted totals, explicit known/unknown counts, visible empty note and formula-safe text; no cross-currency or AR totals.

Workbook tests cover all modes, denied access, invalid mode, multiple currencies, null evidence, empty/paged results, formula-leading labels and original worksheet preservation; document download scope and pass safe Release build/test.
